name: Universal Logistics - Polaris Madison Plant Contract Logistics - Madison AL
type: Contract Logistics / inbound logistics inside manufacturing plant

fieldNotes.locate: Resolved to 7049 Greenbrier Pkwy NW, Madison AL 35756 — the Polaris Industries off-road-vehicle manufacturing plant in the Limestone County / Huntsville-area Greenbrier corridor. Universal Logistics runs inbound contract logistics (sequencing/value-added warehousing) INSIDE the Polaris plant; the audited yard is the Polaris plant's captive freight yard. Confirmed NOT the Mazda-Toyota plant at 9000 Greenbrier Pkwy (a separate, larger facility ~1.5 mi NE). Google geocode returned a ROOFTOP match at 34.6521957,-86.8525792.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The main plant entrance on the north access loop has a clear controlled checkpoint: a guard house structure in the road median with multiple barrier-arm-controlled lanes (visible as striped barrier marks across the lanes), with vehicles queued. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guard house / gatehouse sits in the median of the entrance checkpoint with controlled lanes on each side — a staffed booth. guardShack = true; remoteGs = false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: The checkpoint shows roughly 2 inbound and 2 outbound controlled lanes split around the central guard house — wide multi-lane gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The multi-lane checkpoint and very wide gate apron leave clear physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A manufacturing campus: a large main plant building plus a separate large distribution/warehouse building on the north end and ancillary structures — multiple large building clusters on one property.
fieldNotes.drop: Extensive trailer drop yards — the west side of the plant holds many hundreds of trailers in long rows (inbound parts/components staging for the contract-logistics operation); a second staging/drop area sits at the north warehouse. dropArea 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: The plant has extensive dock banks (a long dock face on the building's west side plus the north warehouse dock bank) — 50+ band; ~70 estimated. Flagged uncertain given plant scale.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks/yards on the west face are physically separate from finished-vehicle outbound staging — separate clusters.
fieldNotes.scale: No distinct truck scale observed in the truck path; scale = false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the plant property observed — railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant sits in open farmland on the edge of the Greenbrier/Huntsville logistics corridor, surrounded by fields — Rural.
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the developed plant footprint — buildings, west drop yards, north warehouse, and employee parking: ~857 m N-S x ~916 m E-W ≈ 194 acres (the overall parcel is larger; the box is the operational/developed area). truckGate box is the north checkpoint.

citations.claim: ULH delivers value-added contract logistics inside ~54 customer-provided facilities; automotive = 47% of revenue (confirms captive-in-customer-plant model)
Polaris Huntsville/Madison AL plant active in 2026 (Slingshot + RANGER); the 2025 Polaris closure was Osceola WI, not Madison AL

verification.rationale: Polaris Madison plant confirmed operating in 2026 (closure risk cleared); Universal's captive inbound-logistics role fits ULH's 10-K customer-facility model and was historically address-attested, but lacks a fresh current re-confirmation, flagged medium.
